[BEGIN]
module TopModule (
    input        clk,
    input        reset,
    input  [2:0] s,
    output       fr2,
    output       fr1,
    output       fr0,
    output       dfr
);

    reg  [2:0] s_prev;   // sensor reading at the previous clock
    reg        rising;   // 1 = level rose at the last sensor change

    // Number of asserted sensors gives the water level (0..3)
    wire [1:0] cnt_now  = s[0]      + s[1]      + s[2];
    wire [1:0] cnt_prev = s_prev[0] + s_prev[1] + s_prev[2];

    // Direction of the most recent sensor change; hold it when no change occurs
    wire rise_now = (cnt_now != cnt_prev) ? (cnt_now > cnt_prev) : rising;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            s_prev <= 3'b000;   // as if water had been low for a long time
            rising <= 1'b1;     // last change was a rise
        end else begin
            s_prev <= s;
            rising <= rise_now;
        end
    end

    reg [3:0] o;   // {fr2, fr1, fr0, dfr}

    always @(*) begin
        case (cnt_now)
            2'd3:    o = 4'b0000;                       // above s[2]: no flow
            2'd2:    o = {1'b0, 1'b0, 1'b1, rise_now};  // between s[2] and s[1]: fr0
            2'd1:    o = {1'b0, 1'b1, 1'b1, rise_now};  // between s[1] and s[0]: fr0, fr1
            default: o = 4'b1111;                       // below s[0]: fr0, fr1, fr2, dfr
        endcase
    end

    assign {fr2, fr1, fr0, dfr} = o;

endmodule
